item.title: Starting this site
item.description:
This is a placeholder first post.

The site is intended to bring together research, projects, code, talks, and general writing without forcing every idea into an academic format.

Future posts can be about research, economics, technology, books, current affairs, programming, data, or anything else worth developing.
